title: Counter Card: The Administration Fee Charged When Coverage Is Given Up
content:
Whether the administration fee the coverage publishes is charged when a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans is given up turns on how long ago the plan was bought, on what the plan's claims record shows, and on the customer's tier in the Belrose Circle Membership Programme.

Where the calendar days since the plan was bought are within the coverage's full-refund window and the plan's count of claims settled stands at zero, no administration fee is charged at all. Where the calendar days since the plan was bought are beyond that window and the customer's membership tier carries a qualifying spend it must be maintained by, the administration fee is charged at the member share, being 0.5 of the fee the coverage publishes. In any other case the administration fee is charged as the coverage publishes it.

## Each case and the fee it carries

| Calendar days since the plan was bought | Further test | Administration fee charged |
|---|---|---|
| within the coverage's full-refund window | the plan's count of claims settled stands at zero | nothing at all |
| beyond that window | the membership tier carries a qualifying spend it must be maintained by | 0.5 of the published fee |
| any other case | | the published fee |

## The windows and fees each plan publishes

| Plan | Full-refund window, calendar days | Administration fee |
|---|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 0 | 0.00 USD |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 30 | 25.00 USD |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 30 | 25.00 USD |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 45 | 35.00 USD |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 60 | 50.00 USD |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 90 | 75.00 USD |

## Boundary readings

A plan whose full-refund window is 45 calendar days, given up on the forty-fifth day with no claim settled on it, is within the window on the first reading and no fee is charged. The same plan given up on the forty-sixth day falls to the later readings: where the membership tier carries a qualifying spend it must be maintained by, 0.5 of the 35.00 USD published fee is charged, being 17.50 USD; otherwise the whole 35.00 USD is charged. A plan given up on the fortieth day that carries one settled claim is not within the first reading either, because that reading is reached only where the count of claims settled stands at zero.
